officialSources.label: Naturkartan: Ostkustleden Etapp 1, Lilla Hycklinge - Nynäs
keyFacts: Current section name and distance 16.0 km.
Section description through Eckern, Högatorp, Eckerhult, Sjoketorp, Lämmedal, Nynäs, Humlenäs, and Hummeln.
Hunting-season notice visible on accessed date.

officialSources.label: Naturkartan GPX: Etapp 1
keyFacts: Official GPX has two tracks; track 2 must be reversed after track 1 to avoid a 4.368 km jump.
Normalized digital line length is 15.985960 km.

officialSources.label: Döderhults Naturskyddsförening: Ostkustleden
keyFacts: Nynäs cabin has about 15 sleeping places, wood stove, no electricity, and water caveat.
Whole-trail fee and camping/tenting payment guidance.

officialSources.label: Naturkartan: Övernattningsstuga Nynäs
keyFacts: Nynäs cabin coordinate, simple standard, no electricity, dry toilet, no outdoor fires.
Current wording says the well has dried/sinat and water from Hummeln must always be boiled.
Page contains a stale/currentness-risk forestry notice for late summer/autumn 2025.

officialSources.label: Naturkartan: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge
keyFacts: Start/end cabin for the circular trail with water in the house, toilet in nearby building, and outdoor grill ring unless fire ban applies.

officialSources.label: Länsstyrelsen Kalmar: Humlenäs naturreservat
keyFacts: Reserve rules relevant to the Nynäs/Humlenäs endpoint.
Dogs must be leashed, camping is limited, and fire is restricted to own grill/friluftskök or designated places.
Dry toilets exist at the farm and Nynässtugan.

officialSources.label: Oskarshamn: Ostkustleden
keyFacts: Confirms Ostkustleden as a 16 mil closed ring with cabins open year-round in broad overview text.

start.label: Lilla Hycklinge / Etapp 1 start

start.notes: Matches the official digital line and is adjacent to Hycklinge Naturcenter parking.

end.coordinateSource: Naturkartan Etapp 1 GPX normalized endpoint and Etapp 2 GPX start
end.notes: High confidence as official digital stage junction, but it is about 565.9 m from the Naturkartan Nynäs cabin marker even though the stage text describes Nynäs/Nynässtugan as the goal.

stageGoalCandidate.label: Nynäs / Övernattningsstuga Nynäs
stageGoalCandidate.notes: Best coordinate for the official overnight cabin and probable human-facing stage goal; endpoint policy should decide whether section geometry should extend here.

primary.storedDirection: track 1 from Lilla Hycklinge to inland join; track 2 from Nynäs/Etapp 2 snap point backward to the same inland join
primary.normalizationRecommendation: Use track 1 followed by reversed track 2, snapping the approximately 0.2 m join.
endpointGapNotes: Raw concatenation creates a 4.368117 km jump from track 1 end to track 2 start.
Track 1 end and track 2 end are approximately 0.2 m apart.
Normalized GPX endpoint is about 565.9 m from the Nynäs cabin marker.
Official GPX endpoint is about 14.3 m from OSM hut-line route start/end connection.

secondary.notes: Simplified Naturkartan line with the same split/reverse semantics as GPX.
Continuous and hut-inclusive when oriented, ending about 48.8 m from the Naturkartan Nynäs cabin marker. Secondary cross-check only until endpoint policy is chosen.
Third-party length aligns with the OSM hut-inclusive line, not the official normalized GPX endpoint.

routeGeometry.importGuidance: Do not import the raw GPX as a flattened line. Normalization must reverse track 2 and then separately decide whether to stop at the official GPX/Etapp 2 snap point or extend/use secondary linework to the Nynäs cabin marker.

closestCommutePoint.name: Lilla Hycklinge
caveats: Naturkartan places the Närtrafik point slightly west of the GPX start.
KLT Närtrafik must be booked in advance.
Busmaps/GTFS line 48 places a Lilla Hycklinge stop near 57.275975, 16.382425, about 10 m from the GPX start; verify exact pickup point in KLT app before travel.

parking.name: Parkering Hycklinge Naturcenter
parking.notes: Free parking between Etapp 1 and Etapp 8.

closestCommutePoint.name: Grytbäcken
closestCommutePoint.distanceBasis: straight-line from Nynässtugan; about 2.2 km by following Etapp 2 from the Etapp 1 end area
caveats: There is no practical bus directly at Nynässtugan.
Official Etapp 1 text says bus connection is available after about 2 km on Etapp 2; Grytbäcken best matches that note.

alternateCommutePoints.name: Humlenäs
alternateCommutePoints.operatorNetwork: Kalmar Länstrafik / KLT line 52/53 per GTFS-derived Busmaps
caveats: Less practical for trail access than Grytbäcken and not the stop naturally reached by Etapp 2 GPX.

parking.name: Humlenäs naturreservat parking / Hitta hit point
parking.notes: Official access via road from Oskarshamn/road 23 toward Kristdala, then signed road to Humlenäs. Reserve rules require parking only at designated places.

taxiFallback.name: Oskarshamns Taxi
taxiFallback.notes: Arrange pickup at Hycklinge parking, Humlenäs parking, or a road/bus-stop area rather than at Nynässtugan.

facilities.name: Lilla Hycklinge trailhead / Etapp 1 start
facilities.description: Official digital start for Etapp 1 at/next to Hycklinge Naturcenter parking.

facilities.name: Parkering Hycklinge Naturcenter
facilities.description: Free parking between Ostkustleden Etapp 1 and Etapp 8, close to the official start.

facilities.name: Busshållplats Lilla Hycklinge
facilities.description: KLT Närtrafik stop that must be pre-booked.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge
facilities.description: Simple Ostkustleden cabin at the ring start/end. Page notes water in the house, toilet in an adjacent building, and a grill ring outside if no fire ban applies.

facilities.name: Nynäs / Övernattningsstuga Nynäs
facilities.description: Official Etapp 1 overnight cabin in Humlenäs near Hummeln. About 15 sleeping places, simple kitchen/wood stove, no electricity. Page includes winter-closure and forestry-currentness caveats.

facilities.name: Nynäs well / drinking water
facilities.description: Well at Nynäs. Naturkartan says the well has dried/sinat and water must be fetched from Hummeln and always boiled; import only with unreliable/non-potable caveat.

facilities.name: Rastbord vid Nynässtugan
facilities.description: Picnic/rest tables by Nynässtugan. Do not model as a fireplace despite any ambiguous object slug; Nynäs page says no outdoor fires.

facilities.name: Humlenäs farm dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at Humlenäs farm; Länsstyrelsen says toilets exist at the farm and at Nynässtugan.

facilities.name: Bord, Humlenäs
facilities.description: Picnic table/information point along Blå leden and close to the Etapp 1 GPX end area.

facilities.name: Humlenäs naturreservat
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM relation 1437340 centroid; official Länsstyrelsen page
facilities.description: Nature reserve and endpoint context with old agricultural landscape, trails, toilets, and small signed swimming access.

facilities.name: Eckern
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM relation 15764508 centroid plus Naturkartan Etapp 1 text
facilities.description: Long narrow lake followed by the route; official text notes Axel 'Döderhultarn' Pettersson's signature carved into rock by the water. Also a reserve water source; do not model as drinking water.

facilities.name: Sandvik
facilities.description: Döderhultarn summer lodging/history near the route.

facilities.name: Högetorp / Högatorp
facilities.description: Döderhultarn's birth village; official Etapp 1 text says the route reaches Högatorp after about 5 km.

facilities.name: Sjoketorp
facilities.description: Settlement passed by the official route before Lämmedal.

facilities.name: Skarpesten
facilities.description: Legend/cultural site near the Sjoketorp-Lämmedal road junction.

facilities.name: Lämmedal
facilities.description: One of Döderhult parish's oldest villages; official Etapp 1 text says the route reaches Lämmedal after about 12 km.

facilities.name: Hummeln
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM relation 9758521 centroid plus official pages
facilities.description: Meteorite lake near Nynäs/Humlenäs. Official text mentions bathing near the end, but no accurate separate Etapp 1 swim-access coordinate was found.

waterSources.name: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge water
waterSources.notes: Water is described as available in the Lilla Hycklinge cabin/house, but separate tap coordinates were not found. Treat as cabin metadata and currentness-check before import as a public water facility.

waterSources.name: Nynäs well
waterSources.notes: Older maintainer text says the well may dry in late summer; current Naturkartan wording says the well has dried/sinat. Do not present as reliable drinking water.

waterSources.name: Lake Hummeln emergency/raw water
waterSources.notes: Naturkartan says water can be fetched from Hummeln and should always be boiled. Hummeln is a protected surface-water source; avoid contamination/soap/washing.

overnightCabins.name: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge
overnightCabins.notes: Simple cabin at start/end of circular route; water and toilet available per object page; fee applies.

overnightCabins.name: Övernattningsstuga Nynäs
overnightCabins.notes: Official Etapp 1 endpoint cabin; about 15 sleeping places, simple kitchen/wood stove, no electricity, dry toilet, unreliable water. Potential winter-closure conflict requires verification.

feesAsOfAccessedDate.notes: Older English page reports 70 SEK; prefer Swedish/Naturkartan current pages.

campingRules: Döderhult cites general allemansrätten guidance for one night of tenting on another person's land when done responsibly.
Humlenäs reserve rules prohibit camping more than one day in the same place.
Tenting at Ostkustleden cabins has a 50 SEK/person fee according to current Swedish maintainer/Naturkartan pages.
fireRules: Humlenäs reserve permits fire only in a brought grill/outdoor stove or designated places.
Nynäs cabin page says no outdoor fires at the cabin and no fire in the upstairs fireplace.
Lilla Hycklinge cabin page notes an outdoor grill ring if no fire ban applies.
Oskarshamn's fire-ban page said no fire ban on 2026-04-29, but same-day fire-ban/risk checks are required because fire status changes quickly.

protectedAreas.name: Humlenäs naturreservat
rules: Camping is limited to max one day in the same place.
Fires only in own grill/friluftskök or designated places.
Motor vehicles only on roads; park only in designated places.
Do not damage trees/shrubs or disturb wildlife/nests; restrictions also cover fungi, mosses, and lichens without permission.

waterProtection.name: Hummeln and Kristdala water source protection
waterProtection.notes: Hummeln is a protected surface-water source. Avoid soap, washing, fuel spills, greywater disposal, or contamination near lakes/streams; spills/leaks that risk water pollution must be reported to 112/relevant authorities.

waterProtection.name: Eckern reserve water source
waterProtection.notes: Oskarshamn lists Eckern as a reserve water source. Exact zone/rule boundary still needs verification before detailed app wording.

hunting.notes: Naturkartan displays an elk-hunting notice for October 8-January 31, advising hikers to respect signs, wear bright clothing, stay on marked trails, and communicate with hunters. The notice was visible on 2026-04-29 outside the stated hunting window; treat as seasonal safety currentness note.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: Naturkartan warns of forestry work near the cabin during late summer/autumn 2025. This is stale by date but still visible; verify whether any access/signage effects remain in 2026.
No official current Etapp 1 closure/reroute found on Naturkartan, Oskarshamn, Länsstyrelsen, or Döderhult pages accessed on 2026-04-29. Field signage may override web pages.

swimmingSafety.notes: Stage text encourages bathing in Hummeln near the endpoint, but no exact official Etapp 1 swimming access coordinate was found. Oskarshamn's official bathing season is June 21-August 15 and water quality can change quickly; do not assume the informal Nynäs access is sampled as an official bathing site.

conditionReports.details: Section-specific account reports a wrong turn at Lämmedal that turned planned Etapp 1 distance from about 17 km into about 21 km, very wet conditions, socks wrung out during breaks, and pressure to reach Nynäs before thunder.
Corroborates the Helenas dagar Etapp 1/2 trip with 17 km plus 4 km due to wrong turn and very wet conditions.
Whole-route review says cabins are fantastic, route can be hard to follow, and AllTrails route is an old version that may not match current marked route. Not section-specific.
First six sections report: tough but beautiful/mixed nature, good cabins, GPS/Google Maps useful, and yellow markings missing on one unspecified section.
Recent whole-route/unclear-section report says very good conditions, easy parking, and insects.
Recent whole-route/unclear-section report says very good conditions.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan section page and Etapp 1 PDF use 16.0/16 km. Döderhults maintainer overview says cirka 17 km. Field report references 17 km plus extra wrong-turn distance.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use 16.0 km as current official section distance, store alternatives, and keep computed geometry distance separate.

sourceContradictions.details: Official GPX/Etapp 2 snap endpoint is 57.3578725758454, 16.2658329902812, about 565.9 m from the Nynäs cabin marker. OSM relation is hut-inclusive and about 16.7 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Must choose endpoint policy before route import; do not hide this in normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: Older/maintainer wording says well exists but may dry in late summer; current Naturkartan cabin page says the well has dried/sinat and lake water must always be boiled.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Treat Nynäs water as unreliable/non-potable pending local confirmation.

sourceContradictions.details: Current Swedish Döderhult/Naturkartan pages say 100 SEK/person in cabin and 50 SEK/person tenting by cabin. Older English page says 70 SEK/night.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use current Swedish/Naturkartan fee for research notes; currentness-check before publication.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan Nynäs cabin page may say cabins are winter-closed 1 November-31 March, while broader Ostkustleden pages say stage cabins are open year-round.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Verify with Döderhults Naturskyddsförening before presenting winter cabin availability.

sourceContradictions.details: AllTrails review from 2025 warns that third-party route may be old and not always match current markings.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use third-party routes only as cross-checks; official GPX/field signage/source contact remain primary.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: No additional agent batch spawned because the user changed scope to stop after overview plus first section and push the work. Section is research-ready for handoff with explicit open questions, not import-ready.

openQuestions: Should the canonical app route endpoint use the official GPX/Etapp 2 snap point, or should the route extend/use secondary linework to the Nynäs cabin marker described as the stage goal?
Is the official GPX missing the roughly 0.56 km to Nynässtugan intentionally, or is it a data defect?
Is Nynässtugan actually winter-closed 1 November-31 March despite broader Ostkustleden pages saying cabins are open year-round?
Is the Nynäs well permanently dry, seasonally dry, or restored since the current Naturkartan wording?
Are any 2025 forestry/RestoRED works near Nynässtugan still affecting route access or signage in 2026?
What is the exact official coordinate for the small Humlenäs/Hummeln swimming access mentioned by Länsstyrelsen?
What are the exact boundary/rules for Eckern as reserve water source, beyond the municipal listing?

blockingIssues: Endpoint policy and route geometry treatment near Nynäs cabin must be decided before route import.
Nynäs winter cabin access and water reliability need confirmation before user-facing availability claims.
Several optional POIs have approximate/OSM-only coordinates and should be filtered during normalization.
Fire-ban and hunting notices are seasonal/currentness-dependent.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: On the next computer, continue from this research packet by resolving Etapp 1 endpoint policy, then start Etapp 2 with the same six-lane agent process.
